items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: At the time he was working with a saxophone player by the name of Ekyan... And they got -- I think they had the band together, Al Romain and Andre Ekyan, they had the band together. And it was just like -- we would work like -- it was more like brotherhood than anything else between us.

ctx.x: He was a bandleader. He had his own band?
He had his own band. He had his own band at that time. At the time he was working with a saxophone player by the name of Ekyan -- have you heard of him?
